name: r1k_PressStartStep
notes: float argument 8.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate; the 600 s idle test is written !(t >= 600) for the x87 compare order

name: r1k_LogoDraw
notes: float constants stored as immediates by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata (same values); stage tint test written as an if chain so cl keeps compares instead of a jump table

name: r1k_StarSpawn
notes: regargs: i=EBX; address folded differently: the original addresses the life field as stage + (i*5 + 0xAD06B)*4 while modern cl uses stage + i*20 + 0x2B41AC (same address); the +-1.0 sign stored as an immediate instead of a load from .rdata; modern cl does the velocity math on the x87 stack (all factors are powers of two and small integers so results are exact)

name: r1k_QueueStepBPop
notes: glyph scale fields are sprite +0x1C/+0x20 of the sprite array at 0x37E0C4 (addresses 0x37E0E0/0x37E0E4); modern cl does the ramp math on the x87 stack where the original uses SSE single precision (behaviour-test priority for rounding of (t - 6i)/6)

name: r1k_LifeLoseStep
notes: address folded differently: the original addresses pip[(health+1)/2 - 1] scale fields as 0x37C4FC + 0x9C*m + 0xA8/0xAC while modern cl uses 0x37C508/0x37C50C + 0x9C*(m+1) (same addresses); 1.0f and 10.0f stored as immediates instead of loads from .rdata; health -= 2 emitted as add -2 (same constant); the 1-or-2 state is built with not/and/inc instead of neg/sbb (1/-1 selection idiom); x87 product of two floats is exact before the single rounding

name: r1k_LifeGainStep
notes: calls 0x000268D0 with EAX=s->queue; address folded differently: the original addresses pip[m] fields as 0x37C4FC + 0x9C*m + 0xA0/0xA8/0xAC while modern cl uses 0x37C500/0x37C508/0x37C50C + 0x9C*(m+1) (same addresses); the 0x44 track stride multiply is done with shl 4/add/scale 4 by modern cl (same stride; track base 0x37CFE4 matches); 1.0f and 10.0f stored as immediates; pending -= 2 emitted as add -2; behaviour-test priority for the (10 - t) * 0.1 rounding on the x87 stack

name: r1k_FieldStarSpawn
notes: regargs: i=EAX; address folded differently: the original addresses the y field as bank + (i*5 + 0x32528)*4 while modern cl uses bank + i*20 + 0xC94A0 (same address); the +-1.0 sign stored as an immediate instead of a load from .rdata; x87 velocity math is exact (powers of two and small integers); twin of r1k_StarSpawn 0x40D20

name: r1k_FieldStarsDraw
notes: regargs: cmd=EDI; calls 0x00058ED0 with EAX=i; 1.0 loaded with fld1 by modern cl instead of from .rdata; modern cl does the grow scale on the x87 stack where the original uses SSE single precision (behaviour-test priority for rounding)

name: r1k_LoadingDraw
notes: regargs: cmd=EDI (forwarded unchanged to 0x000592E0 in EDI); 50.0f and -90.0f stored as immediates instead of loads from .rdata; frame index offset by a constant: the original forms i+25 and i+15 as (i+20)+5 and (i+20)-5 while modern cl folds i+25 directly (same values)

name: r1k_DrawAxes
notes: tail call to 0x0003A2A0 (no arguments; returns the packet end); the multiplications by 0.0 are in the original and kept

name: r1k_ListMergeSort
notes: recursive in-place merge sort of an intrusive doubly linked list (node next/prev/list; list count/head/tail); the unlink is a macro because the original inlines it twice; the second half end is passed as fast which equals last after the split loop (the original pushes last)

name: r1k_TitleStarsDraw
notes: calls 0x00040D20 with EBX=i; 448.0f and 512.0f stored as immediates and 1.0 loaded with fld1 by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata; modern cl does the grow scale on the x87 stack where the original uses SSE single precision (behaviour-test priority for rounding); twin of r1k_FieldStarsDraw

name: r1k_LoadingStep
notes: 30.0f and 300.0f stored as immediates instead of loads from .rdata and the float argument 4.0 pushed from .rdata instead of as an immediate (same values); cases written in the original block order (0 2 3 1/4 5 6 7 8) so the call order matches
